<select id="selectPathNodes" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.associated.ProjectProductConfigurationDO">
        SELECT * FROM proj_project_product_configuration
        WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=b'0'
        <choose>
            <when test="query.paths.size() > 0">
                AND (
                <foreach collection="query.paths" item="path" separator=" OR ">
                    (BINARY project_code <=> BINARY #{path.projectCode}
                     AND BINARY execution_no <=> BINARY #{path.executionNo}
                     AND item_group <=> #{path.itemGroup}
                     AND BINARY bom_path <=> BINARY #{path.bomPath})
                </foreach>
                )
            </when>
            <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectVisiblePage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMasterDO">
        SELECT p.*
        FROM proj_project p
        WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND p.deleted = b'0'
          AND p.id IN
          <foreach collection="query.visibleProjectIds" item="projectId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
              #{projectId}
          </foreach>
          <if test="query.projectNameKeyword != null and query.projectNameKeyword != ''">
              AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.projectNameKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCodePrefix != null and query.projectCodePrefix != ''">
              AND p.project_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.projectCodePrefix}, '%')
          </if>
          <choose>
              <when test="query.status != null and query.status != '' and query.status.matches('S[0-6]')">
                  AND p.current_stage = #{query.status}
                  AND p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
              </when>
              <otherwise>
                  <if test="query.status != null and query.status != ''">
                      AND p.lifecycle_status = #{query.status}
                  </if>
              </otherwise>
          </choose>
          <if test="query.signingMethod != null and query.signingMethod != ''">
              AND p.signing_method = #{query.signingMethod}
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCategory != null and query.projectCategory != ''">
              AND p.project_category = #{query.projectCategory}
          </if>
          <if test="query.implementationMode != null and query.implementationMode != ''">
              AND p.implementation_mode = #{query.implementationMode}
          </if>
          <if test="query.majorProjectLevel != null and query.majorProjectLevel != ''">
              AND p.major_project_level = #{query.majorProjectLevel}
          </if>
          <if test="query.contractNoKeyword != null and query.contractNoKeyword != ''">
              AND p.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNoKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.departmentId != null">
              AND p.department_id = #{query.departmentId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyId != null">
              AND p.company_id = #{query.companyId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeStart != null">
              AND p.create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.create_time < #{query.createTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_close_time >= #{query.closeTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_close_time < #{query.closeTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time >= #{query.refreshTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time < #{query.refreshTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != null and query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != ''">
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_party pp
                  WHERE pp.project_id = p.id
                    AND pp.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                    AND pp.deleted = b'0'
                    AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'
                    AND (pp.effective_from IS NULL OR pp.effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND (pp.effective_to IS NULL OR pp.effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND pp.party_role IN ('AGENT', 'SERVICE_PROVIDER')
                    AND (pp.party_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%')
                      OR pp.party_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%'))
              )
          </if>
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
    </select>

          AND member_role IN
          <foreach collection="query.roleCodes" item="roleCode" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{roleCode}</foreach>
          AND authorization_confirmed = b'1' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = b'0'
          AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
          AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
        ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
    </select>

        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND source_system = #{query.sourceSystem}
